angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 855,711 km at 138.16 pc = 0.08 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.2379 +/- 0.0157 mas (same row, RUWE 0.91): 138.16 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.23 +/- 0.09 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 855,711 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.46 +/- 0.42 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5830 +/- 140 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-95 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-95.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.423, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-95 (pscomppars): spectral type G2, from Hellier et al. 2014 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014MNRAS.440.1982H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-95 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.14 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-95 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.17781, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-95 (pscomppars): age 2.4 Gyr, from Kokori et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023ApJS..265....4K/abstract)
